title: I Took the Neighbor's Drum Hours to the Lease Noise Addendum

parts.text: I printed the lease noise addendum at 8:02 p.m. while the neighbor practiced blast beats past the 8 p.m. line he had initialed. He said art is not noise. I was thirty, WFH walls, holding the PDF. I slid a copy under his door with the initialed clause highlighted and emailed the same to the agent. The practicing stopped at 8:09, which is almost the rule. He texted that I was no fun. Fun is 7:59. I put on headphones for the legal minutes. Drums can live. Clauses can too. The addendum is now on my fridge so I remember I am not imagining 8. Blast beats are a morning sport if the paper says so. I sleep like a person with initials on file.
